fee_notes: Royalty Fee is 6% of Gross Revenue, paid weekly. An Early Franchise Incentive Program reduces Royalty Fee to 3% for the first 12 accounting periods for Franchise Agreements signed in 2026 (store must open within 1 year). Marketing Allocation for Traditional and Co-Branded stores is 3% of Gross Revenue (currently all to Brand Development Fund); Non-Traditional stores pay 1% of Gross Revenue to Brand Development Fund. An additional 1% local marketing spend is recommended but not required. Interest on overdue amounts: lesser of 1.5% per month or highest legal rate. Late charges: 18% per year or highest legal rate, calculated weekly. NSF fee: $50 (increases to $100 for second or subsequent NSF in any rolling 12-month period). Training fee: $1,500 per person (first two trainees at no charge for first store). Renewal fee: 25% of then-current initial franchise fee. Transfer fees range from $1,500 to $10,000 depending on transfer type.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fee | 6% of Gross Revenue | Weekly
Marketing Allocation (Brand Development Fund and Local Marketing) | Traditional Store (i.e., RED MANGO, RED MANGO-Co-Branded with a Third-Party Concept, Co-Branded): 3% of Gross Revenue | Weekly | We currently require you contribute 3% of Gross Revenue to the Brand Development Fund. In addition, we recommend that you spend 1% of Gross Revenue on local marketing.
RED MANGO Non-Traditional Store: 1% of Gross Revenue | Weekly | We require you to contribute 1% of Gross Revenue to the Brand Development Fund and recommend, but do not require, that you spend 1% on local marketing.
Interest | Lesser of 1.5% per month or highest legal rate | On demand
Late Charges | 18% per year or the highest amount allowed by law, calculated weekly | Continues to accrue until paid
Charge for Nonpayment due to "Nonsufficient Funds" ("NSF") | $50 (which will increase to $100 for any second or more NSF during any rolling 12-month period) plus reimbursement of our costs and expenses from your non-payment | On demand
Initial Training and any Additional Training | Currently, $1,500 (per person) | On demand
Renewal Fee (Franchise Agreement) | 25% of the then current initial franchise fee, per store format | Before renewal
Transfer Fee (individual to Business Entity) | $1,500 | Before transfer
Transfer Fee (Owners transferring among themselves or minority interest to third parties) | $2,500 | Before transfer
Transfer Fee (assigning Franchise Agreement or transferring substantially all assets) | $10,000 for RED MANGO Traditional Store or $5,000 for RED MANGO Non-Traditional Store, plus related expenses | Before transfer
